baseline.question: What is the maximum cashback I can earn per statement cycle on the Cashback SBI Card?
baseline.reference: From 1 April 2026 total cashback is capped at Rs 4,000 per statement cycle: up to Rs 2,000 on online spends (5%) and up to Rs 2,000 on offline spends (1%).
baseline.answer: The maximum cashback you can earn per statement cycle on the Cashback SBI Card is ₹4,000 in total. This is split as up to ₹2,000 on online transactions and up to ₹2,000 on offline transactions. [sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.14] [sbi_cashback_revision_2026-04.pdf p.1]
contexts:
[sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.14] Cashback SBI Card | Section: CASHBACK SBI Card FAQ’S

Ans: The maximum cashback that may be earned on online transactions in a statement cycle is `2,000. The maximum cashback that may be earned on Offline transactions in a statement cycle is `2,000. Under no circumstances shall the aggregate cashback in a single statement cycle exceed `4,000.

- For example: If your statement generation date is 11th July, the transactions posted from 12th June to 11th July will be considered under this statement cycle and all eligible online transactions during this period will accrue 5% Cashback and all eligible offline transactions will accrue 1% Cashback. The maximum card cashback that can be earned cumulative of online and offline spends is `4,000. Within the same statement period, all transactions posted after reaching the respective cashback limit of Online (`2,000) and Offline (`2,000) will not accrue any cashback till 11th July.

- Note: Card Cashback is accrued on posting/settlement date of transaction and not on effective date of transaction and accordingly Card Cashback will get accrued on account as per applicable cashback structure at the time of transaction posting.

13. My cashback for current statement shows negative balance. What does it mean? Ans: Your Cashback will be reversed in case of purchase cancellations, reversals and returns. The reversal amount for such transactions will be adjusted/debited in your monthly statement.

- For instance: An online transaction posted on 10th June of ` 40,000 would be eligible for a Card Cashback of 5% i.e. ` 2,000, assuming the statement was generated on 11th June. In that case, the Card Cashback of ` 2,000 will be posted to your account on 13th June.
